items.headline: Masimo, a Danaher company, receives FDA 510(k) clearance for AI-enabled opioid-induced respiratory depression detection feature on Radius VSM wearable monitor
Danaher completes acquisition of Masimo; Masimo becomes wholly owned subsidiary within Danaher’s Diagnostics segment; company to update full-year 2026 guidance with Q2 earnings release
Danaher stock rises ~3% after FDA clearance for Masimo AI-enabled opioid-induced respiratory depression detection feature, seen as positive development for newly integrated business
